items.title: entry: Distinguish habituation and dishabituation
items.prompt: A person turns toward a quiet tone on the first trial but responds less across ten identical harmless tones. No other event occurs. Which process best fits?
options: Habituation to the repeatedly presented tone
Classical conditioning between the tone and another stimulus
Operant punishment contingent on turning toward the tone
Dishabituation caused by a newly introduced stimulus
items.directions: Select one option and commit the choice before feedback is released.

items.directions: Select one option and commit the choice before feedback is released.
